title: Priya's Long Day
subtitle: Repaso para el examen A1: present simple, frecuencia, there is, preguntas…

content.instructions: Escribe la palabra que falta. Si hay una palabra entre paréntesis, úsala en la forma correcta.

items.text: Priya ___ (be) a nurse, and she ___ (have) a very long day. She ___ (get up / always) at six o'clock ___ the morning and she ___ (have) a quick shower. Then she puts on ___ blue uniform. She ___ (be / always) sleepy in the morning!
items.hint: Con he/she el verbo lleva -s (have → has). Always va antes del verbo, pero después de be.
items.explanation: She always gets up, pero She is always sleepy: el adverbio de frecuencia va detrás de be.

items.text: She ___ (not / eat) a big breakfast ___ she is never hungry at that time. She only ___ (drink) a cup of tea. Then she ___ (go) to the hospital by bus. The bus ___ (leave) at a quarter to seven. ___ Saturdays she ___ (walk / usually) to work.
items.hint: Negativa con he/she: doesn't + verbo sin -s. Días de la semana: on.
items.explanation: Después de doesn't el verbo va sin -s: She doesn't eat (no «doesn't eats»).

items.text: The hospital is very big. There ___ (be) six floors and there ___ (be) a small café on the ground floor. Priya ___ (help) the doctors and she ___ (talk) to the patients. "Is there ___ milk for my tea?" an old man asks. "Sorry, there isn't ___ milk today, but there's ___ orange juice."
items.hint: There are + plural, there is + singular. Any en preguntas y negativas, some en afirmativas.

items.text: At one o'clock Priya ___ (have) lunch in the café. "I'd ___ a cheese sandwich and ___ apple, please." "Here you are." "How ___ is that?" "Four pounds fifty." Priya looks at the cakes. "And ___ cakes there, next to the window?" "They're lemon cakes. They're ___ (Sam) favourite!"
items.hint: An delante de sonido vocálico. Para algo lejos de ti: that (singular) / those (plural).

items.text: At home, Lucía has a lot of questions. "___ (you / like) your job?" "Yes, I love it." "What time ___ your shift finish?" "___ seven o'clock in the evening." "And ___ (you / work) at the weekend?" "Yes, I ___. One Saturday a month."
items.hint: Preguntas: do / does + sujeto + verbo. Con la hora: at.
items.explanation: Your shift = it, por eso does: What time does your shift finish?

items.text: Sam and Priya ___ (not / have) the same timetable. Sam ___ (work) at night ___ he sleeps in the morning. "When ___ (Sam / do) the washing-up?" Lucía asks. Priya laughs: "Never! ___ (he / be) a good friend, ___ he's a terrible flatmate!"
items.hint: Sam and Priya = they: don't. Para contrastar dos ideas: but.

vocabulary.definition: a list of times when things happen
washing plates, cups and pans after a meal
special clothes that people wear for their job
the floor of a building at the same level as the street
